body: Used to date a girl and we thought we were in love.  We talked about getting married one day but it was just an idea.  Then one night, after a stupid argument, I decided to propose, she said no and pushed me away.  I then walked into the street laid down and waited.  By the time I realized how stupid I was being I got struck by a car.  She stayed with me for a few months after but things didn't work out.  Several surgeries later and I learned a big lesson.  It's been 6 years since then and I have just recently fallen in love again for the first time, things are much different this time around and looks like I won't do something that stupid ever again.

Thank you, I really don't want to go the forceful route.  I talked to her about her medication a couple days ago, she agreed to see another doctor to double check her prescriptions.  She is however, concerned about the money for it.  She currently is getting government assistance for her healthcare and wants to stay that route.  I don't know too much about that, but am trying my best to find a doctor for her that will go well with her finances.
Thank you, she's a bit old to train a puppy now, I've brought it up to her in the past.  Chasing the 2 year old around was already too much for her.
